cover.headline: 14 stories in 5 minutes. Hormuz tankers burn, tech stocks slide, Binance hit by record hack.

stories.head: Tankers hit in Hormuz as Qatar mediates
body: Iran's Guard says four tankers caught fire in Hormuz. No attacker is named and nothing is independently confirmed.
Qatari mediators reached Tehran with Vance's letter. Trump says the war will be wrapped up soon. Iran has not replied.

stories.head: Tech slides, oil nears $120, Binance hacked
body: Alphabet fell over 12%, Intel 23%, and Amazon over 7% after hours on AI cost fears. The Nasdaq lost over 1%.
Binance estimates a $6.3bn hack, with about $3bn frozen. Bitcoin fell 5% to near $76,400. Brent was heading toward $120.

stories.head: G20 photo scrapped, EU and Canada pair up
body: The US cancelled the G20 photo in Atlanta after European diplomats objected to posing with Russia's Lavrov.
In Montreal, the EU and Canada are forging an 'ever closer association' on trade, raw materials, LNG and Ukraine funding.

stories.head: Poland's court crisis, France in the red
body: Poland: police entered the Constitutional Tribunal and its president was suspended. The court calls it a coup. President Nawrocki flew home.
France: output fell 0.1% and 70,000 officers deploy for Halloween protests. A national strike is set for Nov. 5.

stories.head: Israel deadlock, Gaza, Spain, Russia, Cuba
body: Israel: 53 seats vs 48, 61 needed. Gaza: the UN warns of ethnic cleansing fears. Spain: the rail crash toll is 69.
Russia: Novaya Gazeta will close on Nov. 9. Venezuela: Machado wants 2027 votes. US: a judge blocked a Medicaid rule. Cuba: 30-hour blackouts.
